pet-two-ways: Line chart of daily potential evapotranspiration in millimetres per day over water year 1997 for Sabino Creek near Tucson, Arizona. A solid cyan Hargreaves-Samani line and a dashed amber Priestley-Taylor line follow each other closely: both are low in the cool months and rise to a maximum in early summer. A dotted white horizontal line marks the CAMELS pet_mean.
budyko-camels: Budyko plot of evaporative index E over P against aridity PET over P for 670 CAMELS basins. Dashed grey lines show the energy limit rising from the origin to one and the water limit at E over P equal to one. An amber Fu curve fitted with omega 2.38 and a dotted white curve for the slider value rise below those limits. Small cyan dots are basins, hollow diamonds are snow-influenced basins, and a hatched band below zero marks E over P less than zero. Four course basins are marked by white squares with name labels: Siletz River, Fish River, Leaf River and Sabino Creek.
